title: 4 family members reportedly buried in Pulangbato, Cebu City landslide

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Four members of a family, including two children aged 5 and 6, were reportedly buried in a landslide in Sitio Kandarong Riverside, Barangay Pulangbato, Cebu City, following heavy rainfall on Friday, October 9. The victims, aged 60, 38, 6, and 5, were living in the same house, according to Cebu City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CCDRRMC) chairperson Councilor Dave Tumulak. Extraction efforts are ongoing but have been hampered by continued rainfall and unstable ground conditions, Tumulak said, noting that the soil continues to move amid the rain.
